<thought>We have 15 oxide polymorph JSON files already. To meet the requirement of up to 40 compositions, we will retrieve polymorphs for the next 10 oxide compositions (NiO, CoO, PbO, PbO2, SnO2, TiO, V2O5, WO3, MoO3, ZrO2) using the same energy and count limits, saving them in the same directory.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": ["NiO", "CoO", "PbO", "PbO2", "SnO2", "TiO", "V2O5", "WO3", "MoO3", "ZrO2"],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_12/oxide_polymorphs"
}
